groups.title: Climate-Controlled Units
groups.summary: Units held between 55 and 80 degrees, for electronics, instruments, documents, photographs and furniture.
groups.intro: This Houston location includes climate-controlled storage units that maintain consistent temperature and humidity levels, protecting sensitive belongings from Texas's hot summers and mild winters. They are kept between 55 and 80 degrees, which suits electronics, musical instruments, documents, photographs and furniture that moisture or extreme temperatures could damage. All of them are ground-floor, indoor units.

about.title: Self storage on West 34th Street
text: Our Houston storage facility on West 34th Street offers convenient access for residents throughout the city and surrounding Harris County communities. This location serves homeowners, renters, students and local businesses looking for accessible storage solutions.

The facility provides a range of storage unit sizes to accommodate various storage needs, from compact units suitable for seasonal items to spacious units that can store entire household contents or business inventory. Our staff can assist you in selecting the appropriate unit size based on what you plan to store.

People in Houston use storage units for home moves, job relocations, seasonal storage and life transitions. Families often rent storage when relocating within the area or preparing for long-distance moves, homeowners use storage during renovations or when downsizing, and families appreciate having extra space for seasonal items like holiday decorations or outdoor equipment.
Storage Rentals of America is proud to serve Houston and the surrounding community with secure, accessible storage options and flexible month-to-month leasing.

values.title: Month-to-month leases
values.text: Flexible month-to-month leases — storage without the long-term commitment.

values.title: No deposit required
values.text: There is no deposit to pay when you move in, and the lease is prorated for the first month only.

values.title: Easy move-in
values.text: Move in over the phone, online or at our office. We want to make storage rentals as easy as possible.

facts.heading: Access hours
facts.text: Tenants can reach their units seven days a week from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM through the electronic gate. The leasing office is open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM and Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed Wednesday and Sunday.

facts.heading: Reserving and renting hours
facts.text: Prices and rentals are handled Monday to Friday 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM and Saturday and Sunday 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM, Central time, which is wider than the leasing office hours.

facts.heading: The small print on specials
facts.text: Rates are based on current availability and may change without notice, and all fees are non-refundable. Special and discount pricing is offered on selected units only, subject to availability, for new customers only, and is not available on transfers or additional spaces; it applies to the rental fee alone and requires a reservation and paid reservation fee to guarantee the price. Other restrictions, taxes, tenant protection and fees, including an administrative fee, apply, and the lease is month to month, prorated the first month only, with the final month running until the last day of the month. Online pricing is available only for online reservations and rentals, and actual unit sizes may vary from the approximate estimate on the website, so please inspect any unit before renting.

facts.heading: Moving a vehicle in
facts.text: Our call center can only reserve parking spots. All vehicles must be insured, registered and in running condition, and that information is provided at the facility office at the time of move-in.

faqs.q: What is the easiest way I can rent a storage unit?
faqs.a: Move-in over the phone, online, or at our office! We want to make storage rentals as easy as possible.

faqs.q: Can I tour your storage facility before moving in?
faqs.a: Of course! While you do not need to call ahead, we recommend calling so we can better assist your unique storage situation when you arrive. Our team is eager to help!

faqs.q: Do I need a lock on my storage unit?
faqs.a: Yes, for everyone's safety we require a lock on your storage unit when you move-in. All of our office locations sell locks and no one will have a key except for you.

faqs.q: How long can I rent a storage unit?
faqs.a: As long (or as short) as you like! We offer month-to-month leases with no long-term commitments in order to make the rental process as simple as possible.

faqs.q: What is the difference between climate controlled storage units and drive up storage units?
faqs.a: Climate controlled units are kept between 55 and 80 degrees to protect your valuables against harsh temperatures. Many drive up units allow you to drive your car up to your storage unit for easy loading and unloading.

faqs.q: What are the benefits of climate controlled storage units?
faqs.a: Climate controlled units are great for protecting items of great monetary or sentimental value as they are kept between 55 and 80 degrees.

faqs.q: What parking size space will I need?
faqs.a: Standard vehicles will typically fit into a 20-foot space (most cars, trucks and boats). The width of a parking space is approximately 10 feet unless stated otherwise.

faqs.q: Can I move into a parking space online or over the phone?
faqs.a: Our call center can only reserve parking spots. All vehicles MUST be insured, registered, and in running condition. Information will have to be provided to the storage facility office at time of move in.

faqs.q: How accurate are the storage unit sizes?
faqs.a: We try to get the most accurate numbers for all of our storage units. All storage unit and parking space sizes and measurements are approximate.

faqs.q: Do you have a parking space big enough for my vehicle?
faqs.a: We have parking spaces of all sizes. For the consideration of our other tenants, we ask that you measure your vehicle to ensure it will fit in your designated parking space.

faqs.q: What documentation is required to store a vehicle?
faqs.a: A government issued ID like a driver's license or passport, vehicle registration, and proof of insurance. Check with your insurance provider to see if your policy covers storing your car in long term storage and bring in a copy.
